purpose: Teach: やっこ/一足/脅かす/隔て/嫌気/愉し/溜め/好転

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが冷ややっこを召し上がってらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father is having cold tofu for breakfast.
lines.style: Warm observation, gentle melody rising on his name. Setting a scene rather than announcing. The voice of someone noticing something small and nice happening at home.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに一足早く目覚めの挨拶したよ
lines.en: Mom, I woke Dad up before anyone else this morning.
lines.style: Bright with pride but still respectful. Quick delivery. The eagerness of a young child who's done something he wanted to share. A slight hitch—waiting to see if he did the right thing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、人を脅かすようなふざけ方はやめましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's not startle people with pranks like that anymore, okay?
lines.style: Gentle firmness. Not angry, but clear boundary-setting. The voice of a mother who knows her son and trusts him to understand. Slight pause before the softening word at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがぼくとの距離を隔てて見守って下さってるのかな
lines.en: Mom, do you think Dad keeps a little distance from me on purpose, watching over me?
lines.style: Quiet, wondering tone. The question of a perceptive child trying to understand what he observes. Slight hesitation—vulnerable, genuinely unsure. Trailing upward as though inviting her to help him understand.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは仕事に嫌気が差すことなく頑張ってらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father puts genuine effort into his work without growing tired of it.
lines.style: Thoughtful, affirming tone. Speaking with the quiet certainty of someone who knows her husband well. Slightly slower pace. The voice of a woman reflecting on something she's noticed and wants her son to see too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとの時間を愉しいって感じるよ
lines.en: Mom, I really enjoy the time I spend with Dad.
lines.style: Soft, genuine warmth. No performance—just a small child stating something true he's discovered. Gentle, almost wondering at his own happiness. The contented voice of someone at peace.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、貯金を少しずつ溜める習慣も大事よ
lines.en: Sho, building the habit of saving money little by little is important too.
lines.style: Steady, practical guidance delivered with care. Not lecturing—offering wisdom as she has many times. Slightly slower pace, giving the words room to land. The voice of a parent planting seeds.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんのご機嫌が好転して嬉しいよ
lines.en: Mom, I'm so glad Dad's mood has gotten better.
lines.style: Bright relief and genuine gladness. The happiness of a young child noticing his parent is lighter now. Quick, open delivery. Unguarded joy at seeing something he cares about improve.
